$comment: Region identity colours approved by the project owner. `computed` is the `flags` result that was approved; `colors` are the colours `load` writes to regions.color_hex, which equal `computed` except for any owner `adjustments` (each with its reason). If a later `flags` run computes different colours, these approved colours stay in use and the report flags the difference until a new approval is recorded here.

west.reason: Lightened on the owner's instruction (2026-10-22) so Western Africa stands apart from Eastern Africa's green: same OKLCH hue and chroma, lightness 0.61 to 0.77. CIEDE2000 to Eastern Africa rises from 20.4 to 36.4 (at least 33.4 to every region); simulated colour-vision-deficiency difference at least 10.8; contrast 1.69:1 on the light page.
